scenes.title: The Rising Sun
scenes.subtitle: A classic minor progression.
lines: This lesson teaches a classic minor chord progression using barre chords.
Play it slowly, and let the music rise with you.
It's a traditional instrumental with Am, C, D, F and E chords.
Three beats per bar at 100 bpm — let's start with the first line.
The app will listen through the microphone as you play — just keep the rhythm steady and let the music rise.
